channel.title: Social Media Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Social Media Today (socialmediatoday.com)

item.title: X adds Grok-powered audio option to long-form articles
item.description: Users will now have the option to activate an in-stream listening button, which will prompt the xAI chatbot to read content to them while they scroll.

item.title: X tests new ad format that includes product mention links
item.description: The app recently launched a small-scale trial that displays promotional calls-to-action beneath user posts mentioning product names.

item.title: X quietly adds option to block Grok from editing uploaded media
item.description: Available in post composer, the new toggle enables users to prevent the xAI tool from reimagining material added to the app.

item.title: Instagram, LinkedIn and Threads engagement declined in 2025
item.description: Facebook, Pinterest and TikTok rates increased slightly, while X post engagement grew significantly, according to a report from Buffer.

item.title: Snapchat adds new tools to help brands tap into India’s cricket season
item.description: The expanded suite of ad features includes a live sports API and official team content as the app looks to connect with its growing user base in the region.

item.title: TikTok showcases eight women creators for Women’s History Month
item.description: The company said women including Brittany Wilson Isenhour, Gym Tan and Madison Humphrey were driving discussions in the app.

item.title: Meta outlines improved scam protection in Messenger app
item.description: In a new overview, the company provided details on how its Safe browsing feature operates within direct messaging via Advanced Browsing Protection.

item.title: More scrutiny for xAI’s Grok following racist remarks
item.description: The artificial intelligence chatbot is under new regulatory investigation in the U.K. after users prompted it to roast certain people and groups using "unhinged mode.”

item.title: Bluesky CEO steps down as the app focuses on growth
item.description: Jay Graber will transition to a new role as chief innovation officer while former Automattic CEO Toni Schneider steps in as interim CEO.

item.title: X shares data on women’s usage trends
item.description: In honor of International Women’s Day, the company provided information on the topics women were most engaged in, which included an evolving interest in women’s sports.
